mechanism.claim: A large completed daily change in Cboe OVX relative to VIX identifies rotation of volatility demand toward or away from oil-market risk. If BTC subsequently moves overnight in the implied risk direction through the next session 10:00 ET, the confirmed cross-asset direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.long: delta log(OVX/VIX)<0 and BTC 16:00 ET-to-next-10:00 ET return>0
mechanism.short: delta log(OVX/VIX)>0 and BTC overnight return<0
mechanism.why_distinct: OVRCR uses official OVX/VIX cross-asset volatility rotation. Existing Cboe candidates used VIX, VVIX, SKEW and VIX term maturities; no prior candidate uses oil-specific implied volatility.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the clock activates on unusually large relative repricing of oil-market volatility demand and requires BTC transmission confirmation
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: Gross9 has no external oil-versus-broad-equity volatility rotation clock

clock.source_session: completed common OVX/VIX session S; daily values unavailable for trading until after the session close
clock.btc_confirmation: BTCUSDT return from S 16:00 America/New_York open to next common trading session 10:00 America/New_York open
clock.decision: next session 10:00 ET after OVX/VIX source and BTC confirmation are complete
clock.side: sign of BTC confirmation, required opposite sign of relative-volatility change
clock.reservation: global half-open; chronological signals; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

diagnostic_controls.ovx_change_only: absolute OVX change rank plus usual risk direction
diagnostic_controls.vix_change_only: absolute VIX change rank plus usual risk direction
diagnostic_controls.no_btc_confirmation: relative rotation maps high to SHORT and low to LONG
diagnostic_controls.one_session_stale_rotation: rotation signal lagged one source session

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
